meta.prompt: Build a small checkout in three steps. Step 1, my cart: Espresso beans $24 x1, Ceramic mug $12 x2, Canvas tote $18 x1, with quantities I can change and the subtotal. Step 2, shipping: name, address, city, postcode and email, all required, with a message under a field that is empty or an email without an @. Step 3, payment summary: a choice of Standard delivery ($4, 3 to 5 working days) or Express ($12, next working day) that changes the total, subtotal plus delivery. Then a confirmation with an order number, my name, my email and the total I paid. I can go back a step without losing what I typed.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Checkout" "Three quick steps" icon:"shopping_bag" status:"Step {step} of 3" w:390
  state step=1
  state placed=false
  state items=[{"id":1,"title":"Espresso beans","detail":"$24 each","price":24,"qty":1,"kind":"beans","tone":"sand"},{"id":2,"title":"Ceramic mug","detail":"$12 each","price":12,"qty":2,"kind":"mug","tone":"sky"},{"id":3,"title":"Canvas tote","detail":"$18 each","price":18,"qty":1,"kind":"tote","tone":"mint"}]
  state name=""
  state address=""
  state city=""
  state postcode=""
  state email=""
  state ship="Standard"
  state tried=false
  if !placed
    Steps steps:["Cart","Shipping","Payment"] current:=step
    if step==1
      SectionLabel "Your cart" "{sum(items,x=>x.qty)} items"
      each i in items
        CartLine "{i.title}" "{i.detail}" price:=money(i.price*i.qty,"$",2) qty:=i.qty kind:=i.kind tone:=i.tone -> items=updateWhere(items,x=>x.id==i.id,x=>with(x,"qty",result))
      Details rows:=[["Subtotal",money(sum(items,x=>x.price*x.qty),"$",2)]]
      TotalBar "Subtotal" "Before delivery" amount:=money(sum(items,x=>x.price*x.qty),"$",2) cta:"Shipping" enabled:=sum(items,x=>x.qty)>0 -> step=2
    if step==2
      SectionLabel "Shipping" "All required"
      InputField "Full name" "Ada Lovelace" =name error:=(tried&&trim(name)=="")?"Name is required":""
      InputField "Address" "12 Park Lane" =address error:=(tried&&trim(address)=="")?"Address is required":""
      InputField "City" "London" =city error:=(tried&&trim(city)=="")?"City is required":""
      InputField "Postcode" "N1 9GU" =postcode error:=(tried&&trim(postcode)=="")?"Postcode is required":""
      InputField "Email" "you@example.com" =email keyboard:emailAddress error:=(tried&&trim(email)=="")?"Email is required":((tried&&!contains(email,"@"))?"Email must contain @":"")
      Row gap:10
        ActionButton "Back" tone:"quiet" -> step=1
        ActionButton "Continue" -> tried=true; step=(trim(name)!=""&&trim(address)!=""&&trim(city)!=""&&trim(postcode)!=""&&contains(email,"@"))?3:2
    if step==3
      SectionLabel "Delivery" "Pick one"
      OptionList "Delivery method" =ship options:["Standard","Express"] details:["3 to 5 working days","Next working day"] prices:["$4","$12"]
      Details rows:=[["Subtotal",money(sum(items,x=>x.price*x.qty),"$",2)],["Delivery",ship=="Express"?"$12.00":"$4.00"],["Ship to",name+", "+city]]
      TotalBar "Total" "Subtotal plus delivery" amount:=money(sum(items,x=>x.price*x.qty)+(ship=="Express"?12:4),"$",2) cta:"Pay now" -> placed=true
      ActionButton "Back" tone:"quiet" -> step=2
  if placed
    Receipt "Order confirmed" "Thank you, {name}. A confirmation goes to {email}." code:"ORD-48213" codeLabel:"Order number" tone:"good"
    Details rows:=[["Name",name],["Email",email],["Delivery",ship],["Total paid",money(sum(items,x=>x.price*x.qty)+(ship=="Express"?12:4),"$",2)]]
